fact: The PARGFM coordinator said in May 2025 that land services of 20 communes have been interconnected ahead of deploying the land information system, and that development and deployment of a national land information system is still under way.
title: Burkina/ Gestion du foncier : Le coordonnateur du projet d'appui au renforcement de la gestion du foncier et des mines égrène les acquis du PARGFM/volet foncier
